lit_big_tail: int literal >= 32768 as a function return value; single mov of the tagged value (f851882)
lit_big_cmp: int literal >= 32768 as a comparison operand (f851882)
lit_neg_cmp: large NEGATIVE folded constant as a comparison operand in a user fn (#66, t192)
early_return_labels: two early-return functions in one program collided on .Learly_<n> (#66)
selfloop_crossdep: tail self-call where one new arg reads another arg updated in the same call (6a8551a; was 3 and hangs)
selfloop_constmul: const-multiply in a tail self-call argument (6a8551a; was ~8d+1)
selfloop_div: division in a tail self-call argument (6a8551a)
float_acc_reads_index: float accumulator whose update reads the loop index (was SIGSEGV)
float_arr_new_bare_var: bare int var as float_arr_new length was float-poisoned to a denormal
dotted_ops_real: dotted float operators were cosmetic: +. parsed as + and added raw IEEE bits (ee1608f)
toplevel_const_sub: top-level const in subtraction evaluated as 0 (2026-05-14)
filter_lambda: filter with a lambda predicate segfaulted
wide_mixed_params: 22-param self-loop with an int param next to a float param poisoned the int (this shape passes; the original was inside a training loop)
float_params_callsite: float user-fn params inferred from call sites: arithmetic, int-into-float promotion, 5 float params (t137/t139)
float_result_compose_bare: a float result whose float-ness came only from call sites was int to its consumer (5.27e+36); fixed 2026-09-07 by a second call-site round after the param-aware float-return pass (t193)
head_on_string: head/tail walk cons cells only: a string, tuple, or other heap object yields 0 / [] like an empty list (was SIGSEGV until 2026-09-07, t195)
char_from_int_nul: LIVE, by design for now: join/append/cat/chars measure with strlen, so a 0x00 byte vanishes. Strings from join/append are deliberately allocated OUTSIDE the GC arena (chained malloc) because the compiler frees arena windows with arena_mark/arena_reset while holding them; a 2026-09-07 attempt to build length-tagged results in the arena passed the suite (gen1 still ran on the old runtime) and wedged the compiler at gen2. NUL support needs a representation decision; binary travels as hex or int arrays (stdlib/bytes.rail)
under_application: a call with fewer args than the fn declares ran with garbage params; since 2026-09-07 it is a compile error (arity check in compile_checked)
over_application: a call with more args than the fn declares dropped the extras; since 2026-09-07 it is a compile error
concat_in_let: ++ is not a Rail operator anywhere (not in the grammar, not in stdlib); strings concatenate with + or join "" [..]. Since 2026-09-07 the parser says so instead of "unexpected operator +"
and_or_eager: && and || evaluate BOTH sides; the right side runs even when the left is false (documented in docs/STATUS.md)
div_mod_truncate: integer / truncates toward zero and % takes the sign of the dividend (C semantics)
split_single_char: split takes a single-character delimiter; a multi-char delimiter splits on its first char (use str_split)
selfloop_bigconst: a constant above 65535 as a * or / operand in a tail self-call argument bailed to the tag-corrupting fallback and was SILENTLY wrong (acc * 100000 gave 4340285440); fixed 2026-09-07 (t194)
selfloop_addbig: a constant above 4095 as a + or - operand in a tail self-call argument was emitted as a 12-bit immediate and refused by the assembler; fixed 2026-09-07 (t194)
float_param_bare_mul_lsb: a bare * on two float PARAMS was 2 ulp high: the raw-register param convention (x19..x21, untagged) was chosen by a syntactic check that could not see the call-site float proof, so each float was asr-untagged and lsl/orr-retagged. compile_func now refuses raw registers when any param is __argf_-float (t197, 2026-09-07). Hidden for months by show_float (%.15g); found within an hour of bit-exact comparison
mixed_int_from_fn: an int from a user fn or a builtin (gint 0, length [0]) in mixed arithmetic was read as raw float bits (tagged 3 = 1.5e-323) while an int LITERAL promoted; generic-to-float reads now go through _rail_fval, which converts a tagged int, loads a float box and takes anything else as raw bits; fixed 2026-09-11 with the float representation boundary (t210)
selfloop_compound_arg: a tail self-call argument the direct lowering could not express (`(acc + 2) / 3`, `(n - 1) * 1`, a let-bound value) went through the bottom-test loop with its register never written, or the fallback that moved a TAGGED value into a raw register (heap address / hang / 401); fixed 2026-09-11 (t206, findings F-1003-22/901/902)
selfloop_literal_arg: a plain literal as a tail self-call argument was loaded TAGGED into the raw loop register, so `f (n - 1) 5` ran with acc = 11; fixed 2026-09-11 (t206, finding F-1003-903)
string_ordering: `<` `>` `<=` `>=` on two strings compared whatever eight bytes sat at offset 8 of each object (the runtime had no string branch), so the answer depended on allocation order; fixed 2026-09-11 (t207, finding F-5000-3)
string_param_plus: a 1..3-param fn whose body uses only `+` or an ordering op on its params took the raw-register (untagged int) convention even when every call site passed strings, and the early-return compare read two pointers as ints; the call-site proof now vetoes both; fixed 2026-09-11 (t208, finding F-5000-1)
frame_sibling_lets: five sibling lets in one list literal predicted one frame slot and consumed five (max over siblings vs cumulative threading), the fifth wrote past the frame (SIGBUS); the predictor threads siblings cumulatively and compile_func re-sizes from the slot cg actually reached; fixed 2026-09-11 (t209, finding F-1002-114)
float_from_container: a float stored into a tuple, list or ADT field travelled as raw binary64 bits and the generic runtime dereferenced them (SIGSEGV at 0x3ff8000000000000) or a raw-register fn read them as tagged ints (4.9e-324); floats crossing into a generic location are boxed and generic values read as floats go through _rail_fval; fixed 2026-09-11 (t210, finding F-5000-2)
